heroes.title: The Oathbound Blade
heroes.origin: Ser Royan held the Westreach Gate alone for a night and a day — then broke oath to save the squire beside them, and was stripped of rank for it. The Guild asks no questions about pasts. Only about results.
heroes.motive: Earn a name the bards cannot take back.
heroes.triumph: The Guild struck a medal: a gate, held. Royan hung it on the squire's wall and never spoke of it again.
heroes.epitaph: They held. That was always enough.

heroes.title: The Skyline Runner
heroes.origin: Royan ran contraband through the uncharted currents for six years and never lost a cargo — until the night the cargo was people, and the Guild navy was waiting. The commission is the price of the pardon.
heroes.motive: Map the last blank stretch of sky, then disappear into it.
heroes.triumph: The charts Royan drew that voyage are still standard issue. The margins say: here there be friends.
heroes.epitaph: Gone where the maps end. Send no rescue.

heroes.title: The Cinder Scholar
heroes.origin: Expelled from the Academy for proving — loudly, twice — that the forbidden theorems work. The explosion took the west wing and three eyebrows. The Guild cares about results, and Royan's results are spectacular.
heroes.motive: Prove the equations right in front of everyone.
heroes.triumph: The Academy now teaches the Royan Theorems in the rebuilt west wing. Attendance is mandatory. Eyebrows optional.
heroes.epitaph: The math was right. The math was right. The math—
